name: Aguilar de la Frontera (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the arms of Aguilar de la Frontera (a crowned black eagle bearing a shield).
history: Municipal flag of Aguilar de la Frontera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Aguilar de la Frontera arms — crowned black eagle bearing a shield
